paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: Average performance on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks of models in terms of their parameter count. 70m to 2.8B are , while 7.0B is .
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the average performance on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks as a function of model size, measured in terms of parameter count on a logarithmic scale. The x-axis, labeled "Model Size (log scale)", spans from 70m to 7.0B, with tick marks at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis, labeled "Avg. Performance (%)", ranges from 0 to 80, with major gridlines at 20% intervals. Three metrics are plotted: Precision (red triangles), Recall (blue triangles), and F1-score (purple triangles). The red line representing Precision remains high across all model sizes, starting at approximately 80% for the 70m model and gradually decreasing to about 75% for the 7.0B model. The blue line for Recall shows a steady increase from approximately 10% at 70m to around 50% at 7.0B. The purple line for F1-score also increases steadily, starting at around 15% for the 70m model and rising to approximately 60% for the 7.0B model. All three metrics show a positive correlation with model size, with Precision consistently outperforming the other two metrics.
